author: CNN
description:
Filmed before a live audience of students at The University of Texas at Austin’s Moody College of Communication, this event brings together two of Hollywood’s most dynamic actors, Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey, for a candid discussion about their craft and creative process.

McConaughey can currently be seen in Apple TV+’s “The Lost Bus,” and he won the Oscar for playing Ron Woodroof in “Dallas Buyers Club.” Chalamet, known for his acclaimed performances in Call Me by Your Name, Dune, and A Complete Unknown, recently earned his third Academy Award® nomination for Best Actor for his electrifying turn as a prodigy table-tennis player in A24’s Marty Supreme. 

0:00 Matthew McConaughey and Timothée Chalamet on when they first met 
3:43 Chalamet describes how McConaughey pranked him on the set of “Interstellar” 
5:56 Chalamet on his favorite scene from “Interstellar” 
9:25 What instinct led Chalamet to take a potentially risky role in “Wonka”? 

Stream "A CNN & Variety Town Hal
title: Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey: A CNN & Variety Town Hall Event
